feeds.title: Four Season Foraging
feeds.description: Covers articles about foraging that help learn to identify, harvest, and prepare wild foods and medicines. Four Season Foraging is a Minneapolis-based business that connects people with the resources necessary to start harvesting and preparing wild foods and medicines.

feeds.title: Galloway Wild Foods
feeds.description: The blog cover all areas of foraging including traditional and modern food uses, health and nutrition, traditional and modern medicinal uses, survival and bushcraft, wild booze and lots more. Mark Williams writes about his passion for foraging and teaches about the full range and depth of wild food and foraging including plants, fungi, seaweed, and shellfish.

feeds.title: Sunny Savage
feeds.description: The blog promotes the use of edible invasive species through innovative technology, delicious recipe development, and high quality education. Sunny Savage is an internationally recognized forager who has taught thousands of people about wild foods

feeds.title: Practical Self Reliance
feeds.description: Foraging, Preserving, and Homesteading Adventures. Follow along to learn more practical ways to be self-reliant.

feeds.title: Flora & Forage
feeds.description: A botanically inspired newsletter for plant passionate people. Featuring Secret Stories of the Wildflowers and more...

feeds.title: Backyard Forager
feeds.description: The blog covers a variety of wild food recipes, teaches how to harvest, process and preserve foraged plants and mushrooms. Through her blog Ellen Zachos helps adventurous foodies cook with wild plants and mushrooms, so they can enjoy exciting, un-buyable flavors.

feeds.title: The Mushroom Forager
feeds.description: The blog covers articles on Mushroom Hunting, Medicinal mushrooms, Chanterelles, Boletes, King Stropharia, Porcini, Ramps, Spring foraging, and Foraging with kids. The Mushroom Forager, LLC was founded in 2010 to share the passion for the art and science of hunting wild mushrooms, and to make mycology safer and more accessible.

feeds.title: Eat The Weeds and other things, too
feeds.description: Key topics covered are foraging, permaculture, and other things, too. I'm Green Deane and I've been foraging over 65 years or since I was a kid. My goal is to help people who want to know more about foragables to enjoy the process and be safe while doing so.

feeds.title: Wild Food UK
feeds.description: The blog covers topics on Wild Food Recipes ,Wild Mushroom Guide, Foraging Courses, Private Foraging Events and many more as it aims to educate people about tasty edible wild plants, mushrooms, fruits, roots and flowers. The writers through the blog display their genuine love of the great outdoors and a passion for food.

feeds.title: Original Outdoors » Foraging
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with foraging. Original Outdoors is an established North Wales company, providing outdoor adventure training courses and activities for both novice and experienced clients. We use enthusiastic and professional outdoor instructors to provide you with an enjoyable and memorable learning experience.

feeds.title: FORAGE LONDON & BEYOND
feeds.description: The blog will help you learn about urban wild food, mushroom hunting, wild food, foraging tips, recipes & more. The writer aims at exploring plants, organizing numerous urban foraging events, wild food walks and mushroom forays.

feeds.title: Edible Wild Food Blog
feeds.description: The blog helps you learn about edible weeds (including aquatic plants), mushrooms, trees and shrubs, flowers, wild food recipes, and valuable information about herbal remedies and other related information. EdibleWildFood offers courses, plant walks, workshops and other unique experiences tailored to the needs of your group.

feeds.title: Grow Forage Cook Ferment » Forage
feeds.description: The blog teaches you how to forage and wildcraft through the seasons for your own food and medicine, identify wild plants, roots, berries, and mushrooms. Colleen Codekas, the main person behind the blog aims at inspiring people to live seasonally, become more self sufficient, and protect their health.

feeds.title: Botanical Arts Press | Foraging and Feasting
feeds.description: Covers articles on Foraging and Feasting. Botanical Arts Press is about foraging for wild food, celebrating wild edibles, wild food cooking, the kitchen arts, & educational botanical art.

feeds.title: Wild Food Girl
feeds.description: The blog consists of numerous articles on Foraging and the adventures on collecting and consuming wild edible plants. The writer offers a variety of plant walks and presentations around the state as she teaches courses on edible, medicinal, and tool craft plant identification at Colorado Mountain College in Breckenridge.

feeds.title: JOSH FECTEAU » Wild Edibles
feeds.description: My name is Josh Fecteau. I spend as much time as possible getting to know the natural beings with whom I share a landbase. At about the time I graduated with a degree in Mathematics from Stonehill College, I discovered my passion for the natural world. In 2013, I returned to Maine with a deeper appreciation of the coastal and inland sites I explored in my youth and a growing desire to share my love of the natural world with others hungry for wild connection.
